name: uni-teach
description: Course-note ingestion, planning, tutoring, and spaced recall for the Uni Obsidian vault.

interface.longDescription: Four skills for the local Uni vault: ingest finished course notes, prepare a learning plan with a capable model, teach from that plan with a lighter model, and schedule evidence-based spaced reviews. Learner results remain in the course log.
defaultPrompt: Use the teach skill to teach me a topic from my Uni vault. Ask which topic and how much time I have if I have not provided them.
Use the teach skill to revise a course from my Uni vault, starting with a fresh retrieval question after setting my study time budget.
Use the teach skill to resume my learning from the committed records for the course I select.
